business_problem: ProAssurance needed to move from siloed, legacy insurance operations to a more digital "insurtech" model that could unify claims, underwriting, customer service, and partner interactions without forcing teams and customers through disconnected systems.
solution_summary: ProAssurance built its insurance-service transformation on the ServiceNow AI Platform in layers. It first modernized internal support with IT Service Management, then adopted Financial Services Operations to run end-to-end claims processing from first notice of loss through resolution while exposing underwriting dashboards for submissions, renewals, and endorsements. Customer Service Management added integrated credentialing, billing support, and inquiry handling on the same platform, and a next-generation portal built on the ServiceNow FSO Data Model became the front door for agents and policyholders while "Customer Central" gave internal teams a real-time operating view. RaptorDB Pro then accelerated access to years of policy and customer data, cutting interaction latency. On top of that foundation, ProAssurance launched AI Agents and AI Agent Orchestrator with a curated Unified Knowledge library so support emails can be ingested automatically and templated responses can be drafted without taking people away from higher-value work.

RaptorDB Pro speeds access to policy and customer records, while AI Agents and AI Agent Orchestrator consume support emails and curated knowledge to draft responses and automate follow-up work.
